verdict.rationale: The probe states directly that the dos.fl.gov guidance pages remain open. Substantive text was also extracted from several of those pages (/sunbiz/, /start-business/, /annual-report/), so a non-browser fetch got real readable content rather than a JS shell, CAPTCHA or bot wall. The odd robots.txt result on the separate efile.sunbiz.org filing host concerns the transactional surface, not the public reading surface. Missing for 10: an explicit probe confirming the fetch used an identified user agent with no JS rendering, and independent corroboration that no intermittent bot challenge appears.
